doc.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26

title: Ory prefers Northern California; visit to New Orleans
summary: Ory prefers the Bay Area to smoggy Los Angeles and says he only stopped for hours in New Orleans on his way to Europe.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: They couldn't bury him for a long time. He stayed on ice, you know. You like it in Northern California now better than Los Angeles? Yeah. I do. I'm in account of the smog, you know. Uh-huh. And it's more of a city to me. San Francisco in my sense. It's more like New York, but still I like it better than I do New York. But mostly the smog I hate down there. I thought I was going to have scientists, you know. Oh, yeah. I hate it with this stuff. We love smoke and dust. That's why I'm going down to play like that. Those guys at Beverly Cavern, I want them to stay as long as I want. The 4400 Club Theater. So I feel better here. Yeah, that's good.
You like it over on this?
Especially when we were living here now, you know, the climate is so good. And rest good. And rest good. And no worry.
You haven't been back to New Orleans except just to go through there.
Yeah, I went through that on my way to Europe and back. stuff like stuff
But I only spent a few hours there, I told you, when I went down the foyer on my way to Europe and I ran a call, my wife and I, went out the lake, going to eat some nice seafood, you know.
